name: Zoom AI Companion
summary: Zoom's AI assistant: summaries, Q&A and meeting prep.
description: AI Companion summarizes Zoom meetings, answers questions during the call, drafts chat messages and emails, and helps prepare meetings. It's included in paid Zoom plans.
features: AI for meetings and notes at zoom.com.

howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.
